Every web project must maintain a documented design system: tokens, typography, colors, spacing, reusable components, interaction states, responsive behavior and accessibility. Reuse and evolve the existing system; record its owning path.

Use Impeccable and Hallmark for web UI design and review. Record their source, version, invoked skill or procedure, findings and fixes alongside browser/accessibility evidence. Missing tools or unresolved findings leave the applicable delivery verification incomplete; never substitute a claimed PASS.
